## Glyphling 0.5.2

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.5.2.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place.

### Fixed
- **Installer black edges**: the setup window is now a plain opaque dark window instead of a transparent blurred one, which showed a black rectangle and a Windows title bar on some PCs. Windows 11 gives it rounded corners.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
